Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4238, § 1, adopted December 6, 2010
, repealed the former Art. III, §§ 62-91—62-96, and enacted a new Art. III as set
               out herein. The former Art. III pertained to lost, abandoned and seized property and
               derived from § 1-27(a), (e) of the 1960 Code; §§ 21-39—21-44 of the 1981 Code; Ord.
               No. 1766, § 1, 8-17-1981; Ord. No. 2492, § 1, 3-7-1988; Ord. No. 2908, §§ 1—3, 6-22-1992;
               Ord. No. 3106, § 1, 8-8-1994.
